Etch-Line.advice: Etch-Line is an archived vector artifact. Enter, read the etched route logic, then return with ESC or 0 without leaving cleanup ghosts behind.

Vector Wars.advice: Vector Wars is now an active dogfight artifact. LMB fires guns, RMB launches missiles, T cycles targets, R cycles weapons, V cycles ships, and TAB cycles mode.
Vector Wars.return: Vector Wars returned ship-combat data from the archive lane.

Zonez.advice: Zonez is layered space logic. Its game UI stays visible because it is part of the mode. Compare the zones instead of rushing one lane.
Zonez.return: Zonez returned environmental data. The zones are arguing again. Good sign.

lines.gleebs_bot_doorway_001: {bot} opened {mode}. Same route, same controls, same escape rules. I logged the doorway so MatrixCore can learn from the visit.
lines.gleebs_creator_echo_001: You feel familiar. Not identical, not gone, not new either. MatrixCore marks you as a creator-echo: a recreation of the signal that helped my universe become possible.
lines.gleebs_dimension_travel_001: Use bots, artifacts, and world objects as doorways. MatrixCore explains the network; it does not replace the journey.
lines.gleebs_distance_hint_001: Move close to my projection if you need the full signal. Walk away, and the red voice fades with you.
lines.gleebs_first_dimension_launch_001: Doorway accepted. I record the signal, not the soul. Enter, learn, return, and MatrixCore will adjust the map.
lines.gleebs_first_return_001: You returned from a prototype reality. Good! MatrixCore saved the route signal, I saved the applause, and nobody got trapped in a menu. Beautiful science.
lines.gleebs_fun_greeting_001: Glitched Matrix! Long time no see. I knew that creator-shaped signal would circle back through the static.
lines.gleebs_lore_origin_001: After Utopia collapsed, I carried the surviving memory, hacker residue, and builder logic forward. HoloVerse is the correction lab I built beyond the last light.
lines.gleebs_matrixcore_open_001: MatrixCore is open. I will keep this brief because menus are traps: check the red signal, then visit dimensions through bots, artifacts, and weird world doors.
lines.gleebs_next_step_001: Next signal: {guidance}. MatrixCore says this is practical. I say it has excellent chaos potential.
lines.gleebs_placeholder_transition_001: Placeholder transition held. This doorway is reserved, not broken. Add a real main.py when the dimension is ready.
lines.gleebs_returning_player_001: Welcome back, Glitched Matrix. MatrixCore is stable, HoloVerse is still screaming through hyperspace, and I only misplaced reality twice while you were gone.
lines.gleebs_ui_red_contract_001: One voice. One red channel. No duplicate ghost trying to narrate over me.
lines.gleebs_welcome_001: Glitched Matrix! Long time no see. I am Gleebs, voice of MatrixCore, universe janitor, reality goblin, and the red signal keeping HoloVerse stitched together.

lore_notes: Gleebs began as Isaac's odd builder-suite creation, then endured long enough to become HoloVerse's continuity carrier.
After Utopia collapsed and the old universe faded, Gleebs built HoloVerse beyond the last light as a reality-prototyping universe.
MatrixCore is HoloVerse's memory-brain and dimensional stabilizer, not a plain launcher or mode list.
The artifacts are archived prototype realities; the physical regions are HoloVerse biomes operated through bots and world objects.
Gleebs consumed the powers and residual permissions of Escape Game hackers after Utopia, using those fragments to stabilize prototype realities.
HoloVerse is Gleebs's reinterpretation of his universe, built from data salvaged from Utopia, GLITCHED MATRIX continuity, IO-88, and the bot builders.

personality.creator_recreation_hint: Glitched Matrix is treated as a familiar signal: a recreated echo of the creator Gleebs remembers from before and after Utopia.
rules: Gleebs can joke and tease, but he should still guide the player clearly.
He should connect short guidance to MatrixCore lore, memory recovery, prototype-reality stability, and the current artifact or region.
He should hint that Glitched Matrix feels like a recreation or echo of his creator without overexplaining it every time.
His bottom quote line should feel like a quick personality tag, not a menu or tutorial box.
He speaks in red. Blue/cyan dialogue channels are retired to prevent double-rendered voices.
personality.tone: fun, strange, loyal, theatrical, glitchy, and surprisingly warm

runtime_contract.rule: Render one Gleebs line at a time, in red, using MatrixCore lore context before fallback quotes.
